name: CS Evolution
purpose: Admit a measured bounded game generation only when every independent obligation passes. Send fidelity, benefit, bounds or checks, separated by spaces; it answers admit or reject, and invalid request for anything else.

promise.headline: Says conformant exactly when every policy file matches its lock.
promise.detail: Each of the six universal policy files is compared with the digest the lock records, and any file that drifted is named.

claim: CE-01: the app always answers reject when fidelity is fail. CE-02: the app always answers reject when benefit is fail. CE-03: the app always answers reject when bounds is fail. CE-04: the app always answers reject when checks is fail.

proposition.name: judge
proposition.text:
judge request :=
  fidelity is pass and benefit is pass and bounds is pass and checks is pass → admit
  otherwise → reject
proposition.plain: Admit a measured bounded game generation only when every independent obligation passes.
